post.description:
Provisions a unique LiveKit room, mints a participant access token with the correct agent dispatch baked into `RoomConfiguration`, persists the session record, and returns everything the frontend needs to call `session.start()`.

**GUEST** — generates a random room name and identity; dispatches `welcome-agent`.

**USER** — looks up the profile by `profileUsername`; dispatches `portfolio-agent` with `{ profile_id, profile_username }` in the LiveKit job metadata so the agent can fetch portfolio context on startup.

201.description: Session created. Hand `participantToken` and `livekitUrl` to the LiveKit SDK.

400.description: Validation error — e.g. `profileUsername` is missing or malformed for a USER session.

404.description: No profile found for the given `profileUsername`.

500.description: LiveKit token generation failed — check LIVEKIT_API_KEY / LIVEKIT_API_SECRET.

post.description: Public endpoint called by LiveKit. Authenticity is verified from the signed request body, not a bearer token. `participant_joined` (the minted visitor) transitions a session PENDING → ACTIVE; `room_finished` transitions it to ENDED and records endedAt. Unknown events and rooms are acknowledged with 200 so LiveKit does not retry.

get.description: The authenticated owner's agent-conversation activity. Counts only sessions that reached ACTIVE/ENDED — never PENDING mints — so figures reflect real conversations. Activity is measured from the webhook deploy date onward; older sessions stay PENDING and are excluded.

info.title: Portvilla API
info.description:
REST API for the Portvilla platform.

**Authentication flow:**
1. `POST /auth/register` — create account (verification OTP dispatched)
2. `POST /auth/verify-email` — verify email with OTP
3. `POST /auth/login` — obtain access + refresh tokens
4. `POST /auth/refresh` — rotate tokens when access token expires
5. `POST /auth/logout` — revoke the refresh token

password.description: Password must be 8–64 characters and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character.

email.description: Email address to send the OTP to.

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT for authenticating API requests.

refreshToken.description: Long-lived JWT used to obtain a new access token.
